newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CHEMICAL SECTOR SEES PROFITS EDGING UP IN 97.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CHEMICAL SECTOR SEES PROFITS EDGING UP IN 97.

text.p: Dutch chemical sector earnings are seen increasing slightly year-on-year in 1997, sector organisation VNCI said.
"VNCI expects production to rise slightly and prices to remain stable in 1997," the organisation said.
Net profit is seen increasing to 4.3 billion guilders from an estimated 4.1 billion this year. Turnover will rise to over 50 billion guilders in 1997 from an estimated 49.3 billion.
VNCI said 1996 turnover was expected to fall one percent while this year's earnings would plunge almost 20 percent due to sharply lower average prices.
It said future trends were beset by uncertainties.
"In addition to trends in European demand, sales opportunities outside Europe, especially in Asia, remain uncertain factors," VNCI said.
Sector investments are set to rise some 10 percent to 3.4 billion guilders in 1997, due to several big projects in the pipeline, the organisation said.
Employment in the Dutch chemical industry sector is set to increase in 1997 for the first time in years, rising to around 81,000 people, VNCI added.
